explainer.counted: Refugees from Serbia and Kosovo in Austria on 31 December 2025, as reported to UNHCR.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: Asylum seekers, people never registered, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate. UNHCR adds a footnote to this figure.

footnotes.fn_0adffa0d: Official statistics on the size of the refugee population are not available. UNHCR refugee population estimates is based on the cumulative number of recognized asylum-seekers over the past 10 years, plus the reported number of beneficiaries of Temporary Protection in the country by end-2025 (sourced from EUROSTAT).
footnotes.fn_0c9b9ef9: With regards to stateless statistics, the number of stateless displaced persons have not been available for several years, hence current estimates may not reflect the real numbers currently in the country.
